text:
**Top three reasons for cancelling (out of 40 users):**

| Rank | Reason | Count |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Too expensive after the trial | 12 |
| 2 | Forgot they had it and stopped using it | 9 |
| 3 | Mobile app kept logging them out | 8 |

The remaining reason, no API for automation, was mentioned by 7 users. The counts total 40, so each note was counted once.

**Mentioned only by power users:**

- **No API for automation** (7 power users). This is the only reason in the notes that appears exclusively in power-user interviews and is the most common power-user complaint.
- **CSV exports drop custom fields** (4 power users). This is also power-user only.

Together these account for 11 of the 40 entries. Neither the price nor the forgotten-subscription reasons came up among power users, and the mobile logout issue came up only among casual users.

The user numbers restart within each group, so I've treated every line as a separate person. If some numbers refer to the same person across groups, the totals would change.
